title: Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.06627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a shared framework that adapts Cosmos world foundation models for real-time interactive world simulation in Physical AI. By streaming visual observations in response to actions and scene controls, the framework enables users and embodied agents to interact with evolving virtual environments. It supports both predicting the visual consequences of actions and generating observations from physical state maintained by an external simulator. We demonstrate this approach across camera navigation and robot manipulation, controllable video transfer, and multi-view autonomous vehicle (AV) simulation. These examples provide a shared foundation for developing interactive virtual environments for Physical AI training and evaluation. Our code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3-examples. The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/

translated_title: 基于 Cosmos 的面向物理 AI 的交互式世界仿真
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个共享框架，将 Cosmos 世界基础模型适配用于物理 AI 中的实时交互式世界仿真。通过根据动作和场景控制流式生成视觉观察结果，该框架使用户和具身智能体能够与不断演化的虚拟环境进行交互。它既支持预测动作的视觉后果，也支持根据外部模拟器维护的物理状态生成观察结果。我们在相机导航与机器人操作、可控视频迁移以及多视角自动驾驶汽车（AV）仿真等场景中演示了这一方法。这些示例为开发用于物理 AI 训练与评估的交互式虚拟环境提供了共享基础。我们的代码和模型检查点可在 https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos 和 https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3-examples 获取。项目网站可在 https://research.nvidia.com 访问。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将 Cosmos 世界基础模型适配为实时交互式世界仿真的共享框架，使用户和具身智能体能够通过动作与场景控制同演化的虚拟环境交互，并支持相机导航、机器人操作、可控视频迁移和多视角自动驾驶仿真等应用。
